prompt: Prime-time adult animated sitcom characters with simple rounded cartoon bodies, flat colour and black outlines, but every face is painted with startling real skin: pores, stubble, wrinkles, wet tired eyes, real eyelids, far more lifelike than anything around it, no feature exaggerated. Every colour is laid on in thick visible oil brushstrokes. Night just after rain on a 1930s city street: wet cobbles, an iron street lamp, a small bakery with a lit cream shop window full of loaves and a plain sign with no lettering, an ultramarine sky with a small red moon. A long lens down the street from the corner: in the middle distance, under the street lamp outside the lit bakery, two crowds of working people in overalls, aprons, flat caps and factory smocks, each crowd young and old, men and women, Black, white and South Asian: one wears red scarves and waves plain red banners with no writing, the other wears blue scarves and waves plain blue banners with no writing, every face turned towards the other crowd, shoving and fighting, two black police cars nose to nose with headlamps on. In the near foreground on the right, on the pavement, a gangster in a pinstripe suit and fedora strolls past towards us with a fat sack over his shoulder, unhurried, his real-skinned face calm, and not one person looks at him. Wet cobbles streaked with lamp and headlamp light. Most of the frame in shadow; the brightest values are the lamp's pool, the headlamps and the shop window. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
